title: Introduction to R
desc: A foundation in R: installation, data types, functions, and reading and writing data.
abstract: The starting point for everything. Covers R installation, RStudio setup, core data types, basic functions, and reading/writing files.

title: Data Manipulation in R
desc: From data creation to wrangling: tidyverse pipelines, wide/long pivots and the Palmer Penguins dataset.
abstract: Covers the full tidyverse pipeline: filtering, mutating, grouping, summarising, and reshaping data.

title: Data Visualisation in R
desc: Base R plots to publication-quality facetted ggplots — the complete visualisation toolkit.
abstract: From quick base plots to layered, publication-ready ggplot2 figures with custom themes, scales, and facets.

title: Introduction to Machine Learning in R
desc: Supervised and unsupervised ML workflows in R: classification, regression and clustering.
abstract: Core ML workflow in R — data splitting, model training, validation, and evaluation for classification and regression.

title: Spatial Data in R
desc: First steps in spatial R: reading, plotting, manipulating and combining vector and raster data.
abstract: Introduction to spatial data science in R using sf and terra. CRS, basic operations, and plotting.

title: Rasters in Different Projections
desc: CRS in practice: bathymetry rasters reprojected and mapped alongside shapefiles.
abstract: Deep dive into coordinate reference systems in R. Reads bathymetry rasters and shapefiles, reprojects them, and builds complex multi-layer maps.

title: Mapping with Satellite Imagery
desc: Landsat-based NDVI, and RGB composite mapping in R.
abstract: Loading multi-band Landsat rasters, producing RGB composites and computing NDVI

title: Landsat Spectral Band Analysis
desc: Exploring Landsat spectral bands, band combinations and spectral profiles for land cover discrimination.
abstract: Band combinations, spectral signatures, and how different land cover types appear across the electromagnetic spectrum.

title: NDBI & Built-Up Mapping — Gauteng
desc: Normalised Difference Built-up Index computed from Landsat to map urban extent across Gauteng.
abstract: Computes NDBI from Landsat imagery to map and quantify urban and built-up land cover across Gauteng.

title: Urban Change Detection — Gauteng
desc: Multi-temporal Landsat analysis to detect and quantify urban expansion in Gauteng.
abstract: Multi-date Landsat imagery to detect and map urban expansion across Gauteng using change detection methods.

title: Fiji Earthquake Data Analysis
desc: Exploratory analysis of the Fiji earthquake dataset: spatial distribution, magnitude and depth patterns.
abstract: Investigates the spatial distribution of Fiji seismic events, depth and magnitude distributions, and correlations.

title: Fiji Earthquakes — Advanced Analysis
desc: A continuation: Interactive map of Fiji seismicity.
abstract: Continues from Part 1 with tutorial of plotting an interactive map.

title: Marine Heatwave Analysis
desc: Detection and characterisation of marine heatwave events using sea surface temperature data.
abstract: Detect and characterise marine heatwave events using SST time series following the Hobday et al. framework.

title: Whale Occurrence & Distribution Analysis
desc: Spatial analysis of whale occurrence records: distribution mapping, hotspots and environmental drivers.
abstract: Maps whale species distribution, identifies hotspot areas, and explores environmental correlates using GBIF data.

file: Diel vertical migration of Euphausia lucens.ipynb
title: Diel Vertical Migration of Euphausia lucens
desc: Quantitative analysis of krill DVM at inshore and offshore stations in St Helena Bay.
abstract: Analysis of diel vertical migration of Euphausia lucens at inshore/offshore stations in St Helena Bay, investigating environmental drivers.
